review.notes: Full review. All six findings of the previous review (d3857c3) are repaired. Two P3 findings: R01 (6.4: Fricke's sigma is not an eta quotient, sigma(i/sqrt 21) = 0 by Ligozat p. 41; the j(z), j(Nz) birationality step is quoted from Fricke 1922 and has no supplier; replace by a pole count) and R02 (3.3/4.5: 'members of the two classes are commensurable' needs its quantifiers; E' = E, g = [[1,1],[0,1]] gives two non-commensurable members of one CM class). Gate rerun: OK, every count 0; depcheck 233 roadmaps, 2263 edges, 0 problems; nothing changed outside the folder; pins equal main's. lake env lean: 25 sorry warnings only; 45 elaborated signatures compared with the README; one-tactic probe (rfl | simp | infer_instance) fails at all 25 sites. Seeded sample (0.3, 1.2, 1.4, 2.2, 2.6, 2.8, 4.3, 4.4, 5.1, 5.2, 5.6, 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 7.3) and all locators added this round checked against serre1972, mazur1977, reichert1986, ligozat1975, belov2019, rszb2022, zywina2022, dieulefait2002 and the supplier roadmaps at their heads. Finite enumerations: the l = 2 lifting thresholds of 2.2, cusps and rational cusps of X1(14), X1(15), X1(16), X1(18), the Reichert substitutions, the model point lists. Not verifiable: Prasad-Rajan 2003 (paywalled), Serre's Abelian l-adic representations, Mitchell 1914, Bray-Holt-Roney-Dougal, Fricke 1922, LMFDB data.
